protocol.comparison: Teacher-selected terminal success vs paired before-only and uniform candidate choice; task-cluster intervals; no best-of-five success oracle.
protocol.equivalence: Exact observed storage/page/forms/tabs/scroll plus frozen pixel tolerance; hidden remote/JS state is not proven cloned.
protocol.gate: Stop if first twelve candidate states yield zero accepted states; release all fifteen branches only after reconstruction.
protocol.intervention: Whole candidate response (reasoning and grounded action bundle) enters actor history.
protocol.outcome: Canonical OM2W o4-mini-2025-04-16,4096 response cap; original terminal status retained.
protocol.remaining_horizon: 30 total browser operations and60 total policy decisions minus common prefix; 1800s after release.
protocol.replay: Fresh independent browser contexts; identical prefix responses; compare every prefix observation and anchor.
protocol.scope: No mixed-policy training data and no critic fitting; branch collection and teacher diagnostic only.

teachers.leakage: Allowlisted pre-action and immediate observations only; suffix/terminal evidence unavailable.
teachers.legacy: Original selection-index output formulation adapted to three candidates; not an exact prompt replication.
teachers.permutation_check: One extra before and one after(rep0) call per form/state
